records.sample_scope: Design research; Cycle 1 qualitatively analyzed 20 middle-school students, with Cycle 2 tracing focus-pair learning and patterns typical of 18 students.
records.supports: Understanding unit conversion requires coordinating bundle, place-value and refinement structures; students can know a procedure without being able to explain/justify its structure.
records.does_not_support: Prevalence of a specific unit-conversion misconception in primary pupils or a jurisdiction-specific claim.
records.use_note: Use as broader direct mechanism evidence with age-range caution.

records.sample_scope: Kindergarten children discussing fairness in probabilistic games involving spinners.
records.supports: Young children may initially reason inadequately about spinner fairness and can develop attention to sector size/area as relevant to chance.
records.does_not_support: A universal prevalence estimate or diagnosis from one spinner response.
records.use_note: Direct child evidence for unequal-sector/fairness reasoning; keep task and age scope visible.

records.sample_scope: Longitudinal individual-interview case studies of two students across Grades 5-7 over five semesters.
records.supports: A robust multiplication conception as repeated addition/equal groups can constrain use of commutativity and, for one student, sense-making for decimal multiplication.
records.does_not_support: Prevalence of this conception among primary pupils or a claim that repeated addition is inherently harmful.
records.use_note: Direct empirical evidence that the limited conception can occur; very small sample requires strong caution.

records.sample_scope: 42 Year 2 children in England, mean age 6 years 7 months, randomly assigned to repeated-addition or correspondence-schema interventions.
records.supports: Children taught through correspondence made greater progress on multiplicative reasoning than children taught through repeated addition; repeated addition functions as a calculation route but need not constitute the full conceptual basis of multiplication.
records.does_not_support: That repeated addition should never be taught or that a particular pupil using repeated addition has a misconception.
records.use_note: Use to support broadening multiplication meaning beyond repeated addition, not to diagnose from strategy use alone.
